checks_run.procedure: Source review of workflows/gates.ts, criteria.ts, transformations/phase.ts and migration 0017. Checks: the approver resolves through authorize(gate.decide) plus the role or named user; the submitter (or someone acting for them) gets 403; a stale submissionNo or a non-pending submission gets 409 with nothing written; the DB gate_decision_guard repeats both rules; the approver is frozen on the submission and cannot change while one is pending; submit re-evaluates the criteria inside the transaction (422 + pointers, nothing written); the snapshot is SHA-256 hashed and gate_submission_freeze makes it immutable; a missing evaluator fails closed. grep apps/*/src and packages/*/src for docs/delivery, stages.json, tools/gates and gates/DG.
checks_run.expected: rules implemented in API + DB; the product gates neither read nor write any DG0-DG7 record
checks_run.actual: Implemented as expected. The grep hits only two *.test.ts files (branding.test.ts, kpi.test.ts), none in runtime code, and no route reads or writes DG records. Gate-decision concurrency uses body.submissionNo plus row locks instead of If-Match, which is acceptable because the 409 is enforced.

checks_run.procedure: Source review. (a) packages/shared/src/value.ts and the kpi module: decimal.js only, no parseFloat/Number on amounts; pg numeric stays a string (pool.ts overrides only the date OID 1082); unquantified pools are counted, never added as 0; a validated total counts only current, non-stale validations. (b) charter.ts: every POST/PATCH appends a charter_version snapshot in the same transaction; baselineDate uses the businessDate schema (an invalid date gives 400 with a pointer); PATCH requires If-Match. (c) evidence/store.ts: keys are server-generated (org/transformation/evidence/uuidv7); a KEY regex, a '..' ban and a resolve+startsWith(root) check confine paths; download goes through transformation.read with attachment + nosniff + no-store. (d) requireIfMatch is used by every P2 update; the routes without it are creates or the gate decision.
checks_run.expected: decimal-safe, versioned charter, confined store, If-Match on updates
checks_run.actual: All four hold as expected. Unit and integration suites covering them pass (SEC-R1-07..10).

summary: FAIL. Every mechanical check passes on the frozen candidate: build, typecheck, lint, openapi lint, no-CDN, format, unit on Node 22 and 24 (465/465), integration twice on disposable PG16 (414/414, including contract, gates and the 127-case AUD sweep), and historical validation of DG0 and DG1. My own probes confirm cross-org/wrong-scope 404, AUD 403 with a denied-mutation audit event, and every migration-0010 DB guard. Three new separation-of-duties/authorization defects were reproduced through the API, in two runs each. F-DG2-140 (High, mandatory): a reviewer can verify evidence content they wrote or uploaded on someone else's item. F-DG2-141 (High, mandatory): a BO can set a T02 target and approve it themselves. F-DG2-142 (Medium, mandatory): any evidence.create holder can remove evidence links without the record edit rights that link creation requires. Environmental residuals D-057/D-058/D-049 are not in this assignment's requirement set and are not recorded as checks.
